Subject: Eval kickoff - next steps

Thanks Marissa & Ethan,

Really appreciated the call today - the discovery was helpful. ACME is keen to move to an evaluation sandbox to validate Redwood against our key success criteria (latency under production-like load, prompt fidelity on our domain-specific prompts, and cost per 1M tokens).

To keep momentum, can we schedule a 45-60 minute evaluation kickoff next week to cover:
- Trial plan & timeline (what success looks like)
- Access & credentials (test org, API keys, IP allowlists)
- Prompt set & evals (we'll share an initial prompt set and test cases)
- Security checklist items we flagged (SOC2 audit evidence, data handling)

Our preferred windows (PDT):
- Tue 2026-08-11: 10:00-12:00 or 15:00-16:00
- Wed 2026-08-12: 09:00-11:00

I'll also include our procurement contact (liam.oconnor@acme.com) for the kickoff so we can align on timing and next steps for PO/contract.

Attaching a short requirements summary we mentioned.

Thanks,
Samira Kahn
Director, Product
ACME Corp

Attachments: ACME_requirements_summary.docx (docx, 42KB)

Hi Samira - great to meet you yesterday, and thanks for the clear summary.

We're excited to run an evaluation with ACME. I can do a 45-minute kickoff on Tuesday 8/11 at 10:30am PDT or Wednesday 8/12 at 09:30am PDT. If neither works, send a time that does and I'll accept.

Proposed kickoff agenda (45 minutes):
1) Introductions & success criteria (5m)
2) Trial plan & timeline (10m) - what we'll enable vs what ACME will test
3) Prompt set & evaluation approach (10m) - how we'll run regressions and capture outputs
4) Access & security checklist (10m) - keys, network, data retention, SOC2 artifacts
5) Next steps & mutual action plan (10m)

Pre-read I'll share before the meeting: mutual action plan draft, eval templates (prompt set spreadsheet), and a short security FAQ. Ethan (SE) will join for the technical pieces; Naomi (Customer Success) will run the eval coordination.

For calendar ease: my scheduling link is https://cal.redwood.ai/marissa/30 - feel free to book the slot that works for you. I'll also attach a draft Mutual Action Plan for review.

Best,
Marissa Cole
